inspection_assigned.name: Inspection Assigned
inspection_assigned.body_template: You have been assigned to conduct an inspection for asset '{asset_name}'.

inspection_completed.name: Inspection Fieldwork Completed
inspection_completed.body_template: Inspection #{entity_id} for asset '{asset_name}' has been completed and is ready for engineering review.

damage_detected.name: Structural Damage Detected
damage_detected.body_template: AI model detected potential damage on asset '{asset_name}' during inspection #{entity_id}. AI result for engineer review, not a final structural safety verdict.

critical_alert.name: Critical Severity Alert
critical_alert.body_template: CRITICAL condition assessed during inspection #{entity_id}. Qualified engineering review required immediately. AI result for engineer review, not a final structural safety verdict.

maintenance_deadline_approaching.name: Maintenance Deadline Reminder
maintenance_deadline_approaching.body_template: Maintenance task '{task_title}' (Priority: {priority}) for asset '{asset_name}' is due within 48 hours.

report_generated.name: Inspection Report Generated
report_generated.body_template: Report snapshot v{version} ({status}) for inspection #{entity_id} is now available for review and download.
